_comments: One category for the whole Forms API surface. Eighteen operations is a catalog a person or an
agent can scan in one list; splitting it would only add a click.
A fixed UUID rather than a lookup target: every operation row @lookups this category by name,
and a stable id means a re-push against a rebuilt database resolves to the same row.

fields.Name: Forms
fields.Description: MJ Forms: publish, clone, template, archive and restore forms; issue and manage share links; configure on-submit automations; report on responses; and the respondent read and save path.
